entities.summary: Tati Zaqui (b. 1994-02-18, São Caetano do Sul) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in São Caetano do Sul and Brazil. Known in the fields of brazil, composers & musicians, americas.
